interpretation.finding: The original 2630-row OCR universe was a prioritisation subset, not the full set of products with Mercadona perspective=9 imagery.
interpretation.risk: The 1515-row remainder contains many non-food categories, so processing it indiscriminately would waste OCR and increase false-positive exposure.
interpretation.next_safe_step: Pilot the no-ingredients remainder only where independent first-party food signals exist (legal denomination/name or allergens); keep packaging alone insufficient because it is common in non-food products.
